objective.statement: Continue real development by reviewing the new project checkpoint adapter for an actionable custody or recovery defect.
objective.done_when: Return one concrete supported issue and a minimal fix/test proposal, or explain why no actionable issue is established.
constraints: Review only this public project. Do not claim code execution or repository access: receiver has supplied text only.
Distinguish context sufficient to select an action from source needed to perform that action.
Current adapter source is committed in caf7880; do not assume proposed capabilities are implemented.

decisions.statement: Use a fresh disposable store and committed regular Git source. Native core remains independent of Git.
decisions.reopen_when: Observed use requires retained store upgrades or a broader source representation.

uncertainties.question: Does the adapter lose a decision-relevant artifact or misrepresent provenance under plausible inputs?
uncertainties.why_it_matters: A completed checkpoint should enable useful continuation without concealing what was captured.

handoff.scope: Review the adapter and propose a bounded next implementation using the supplied source. Report needed/missing/unused context and extra retrieval; no tools are available to this receiver.
